metadata.title: Energy effiency and technology are at the heart of sustainable marine operations

eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: The EEDI requires a minimum energy efficiency level (CO2 emissions) per capacity mile
eligibility.methodological_eligibility.rule: §5.2: EEDI apresentado com mensurando (CO2 por milha de capacidade), variaveis e baseline associada; nao e mencao incidental. Sem exclusao topical (logistica maritima e aerea de petroleo e gas offshore).
